authoritative_native_observation.operation: bpftrace 0.20.2 raw_syscalls:sys_enter probe filtered to the actual public-reader process PID and native Java main-thread TID, while it waits before CgroupBudget.open.
authoritative_native_observation.main_thread_identity: Driver obtains its native TID from /proc/thread-self and publishes PID/TID before its release wait. Probe filter checks both. Every raw observer argv/stdout/stderr is retained per case.
authoritative_native_observation.cgroup_namespace_truth: Read actual current task_struct.nsproxy.cgroup_ns using kernel BTF and compare with the actual kernel init_cgroup_ns symbol address. Host readers match; the controlled hidden-inner reader differs.
authoritative_native_observation.mount_namespace_truth: Compare the actual reader task mount namespace pointer with init_nsproxy.mnt_ns. Host readers match; the controlled inner private mount namespace differs.
authoritative_native_observation.boot_init_context: Provider launch identity, boot UUID, actual PID1 executable and PID/user/cgroup/mount namespace identities are retained in setup.json and preflight receipts. Initial-namespace classification comes from the native kernel comparison, rather than numeric inode constants, VM label or equality with /proc/1.
authoritative_native_observation.actual_root_mapping: Host reader runs in initial cgroup and mount namespaces; findmnt reports kernel cgroup2 at /sys/fs/cgroup with FSROOT=/. The newly created parent is directly beneath that root. Mapping receipts record the actual target PID in leaf/cgroup.procs and its host-view /proc/PID/cgroup path.
authoritative_native_observation.binding_to_consumer: Diagnostic controller consumes the native observer result for the exact published PID/TID and grants complete visibility only when both initial namespace flags and the supplied reader identity match. It then writes the authority/release files. The same Java main thread opens libcgroup after release in its final namespace; its source does not switch namespaces.
authoritative_native_observation.runtime_identity: runtime-identities.json inside the native archive pins BTF, bpftrace, Java/JVM and acquired libcgroup artifacts.
authoritative_native_observation.limitations: This is privileged kernel introspection on the observed Ubuntu kernel, not a stable portable Java API. Missing symbols/BTF, failed BPF attachment or ambiguous task identity must leave provenance unknown; no production fallback or general-container self-certification was implemented.
